actualDefects.repair: Reject numeric or hexadecimal final hostname components, preserving canonical DNS and exact bind/origin address rules.

actualDefects.firstDiscovery: Independent scaled native TLS teardown oracle with a controlled held Store boundary.
actualDefects.failure: jobs.close acquired the shared store/request lock before the bounded request join and could exceed that join budget.
actualDefects.repair: HTTPS shutdown closes admitted sockets, then joins requests within REQUEST_JOIN_SECONDS before jobs.close and database/lifetime-lock teardown. Refusal retains Store and lock for later close.
actualDefects.testBoundary: Producer holds Store.snapshot for at most 2 seconds and scales REQUEST_JOIN_SECONDS to 0.15; this is a labeled lifecycle branch test, not a measured production 5-second join deadline.

actualDefects.repair: HTTPS server_bind calls TCPServer.server_bind directly, retaining its socket options without HTTPServer reverse DNS. The default loopback branch is unchanged.

assertedBoundaries: Config/TLS/setup input admission completes before library creation; HTTPS bind/listen also precedes Store construction and startup pause.
Source TLS/setup files use regular NOFOLLOW bounded reads. Native SSL receives owned in-memory copies of the admitted bytes, never rebound source paths.
Only 16 admitted raw/SSL sockets, one watchdog, handshake off accept loop; per-phase and total deadlines use exact owned connection identity.
HTTP syntax header counts exclude prefetched body bytes; authentication, Origin, setup and framing gates precede body admission.
Setup key is creation-only; room capabilities remain independent, media cookies gain Secure only for HTTPS.
Request/media cleanup must finish before SQLite and lifetime lock release; failed bounded request join retains ownership.
limitations: No reruns were performed to create this receipt; timings and outcomes are retained historical runs and their source-stage distinctions are explicit.
The 11-test producer run is the final owned configuration/runtime run. The 182-test root run precedes the added restart test/repair and is not claimed as final-head verification.
Native evidence is four successful original cases plus the unchanged affected case after repair, not a claimed single all-five rerun.
Production network deadline measurements and other protocol/security cases belong to the independent oracle receipt; producer scaled held-Store testing only verifies its declared shutdown branch.
Software loopback TLS tests do not establish physical two-device audio synchronization, arbitrary network latency or normal trust on every client device.
Server key-pair loading does not prove certificate hostname/expiry/chain/browser trust; these remain operator/client responsibilities.
No certificate private keys, setup key values, participant capabilities, input file contents or private URLs are included.
